newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for Jan 27.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for Jan 27.

text.p: All Mexico's main ports were reported open Monday, the Communications and Transport Ministry said in its 1000 local/1600 GMT daily report.
A cold front heading northeast could lower temperatures throughout the country's north and northeast regions by later in the day.
The ministry updated port and shipping conditions for the Gulf of Mexico, Caribbean and Pacific Coast.

Clear skies and warm temperatures along the Pacific beaches, except for some stong, northeast winds diminishing in the Gulf of Tehuantepec, reported at 15 to 25 knots (28 to 47 km/17 to 28 miles per hour) with waves at six to nine feet.

Sunny skies along most of the coastline. A cold front expected during the evening with winds estimated from the north and northeast at 15 to 20 knots (28 to 38 km/17 to 22 miles per hour) lowering temperatures in the north, northeast and center of the country.

Moderate convective activity over Belize, Honduras, Guatemala and Nicaragua bringing clouds and isolated rains along coast of Quintana Roo state. Winds from the east and northeast at 10 to 15 knots (19 to 28 km/11 ti 17 miles per hour).
